why: Build round 1 for lead tooling slice lint-dead-test-support, branch fabrikalfa/lint-dead-test-support, from 4aa8bc9. Sent to tests: stepcommit.sh refused the commit with 'stepcommit: a build may not commit exam paths; answer send to tests', because exam-paths.json lists patches/**, pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml, and the fix is a change to patches/@demlik__code-graph@0.15.0.patch plus its lockfile hash. Nothing of the patch is committed. The patch itself works: made with pnpm patch @demlik/code-graph@0.15.0 and pnpm patch-commit, it changes two places in dist/index.js. In judge (src/query/unreachable.ts) the first test becomes 'if (isTestLike(fn.file) && (isTestFile(fn.file) || (refs.identifierFiles.get(fn.name) ?? []).some((f) => f !== fn.file)))', so a test-support export that no other file names goes on to be judged and can be dead. In isCandidate (src/query/unused-exports.ts) the last clause '!scope.isTestLike(symbol.file)' becomes '!isTestFile(symbol.file)', so a test-support symbol reaches usedElsewhere, which skips one the tests use. The old patch's hunks keep their lines; only their new-side line numbers move by 5 and the index line's new blob hash changes. The lockfile's code-graph patch_hash goes from 9642ccde... to 2dd91ed5.... The package ships no src/, and no .d.ts changes; dist/index.js.map is not patched, as the old patch also left it, so the map's lines below each hunk are off by the added lines. With the patch installed, law 4 and laws 1 to 3 are green, but pnpm lint:dead fails with 14 new findings that the old withhold hid, 13 of them in exam paths, so the patch cannot land without them being resolved in the same change.

NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 nice -n 19 pnpm lint:dead: exit 1, 'UNREACHABLE LEDGER FAILED, 14 finding(s) in scope . not in unreachable-ledger.json'. All but clamp.ts are exam paths (next/**/*.test-support.ts, fixtures/next/**). No ledger entry was added (0524), and the ledger was not pruned. loosening.sh 701a651 HEAD: exit 1, 'node-kinds.json: unrecognized change: line 7'. node-kinds.json is itself an exam path (exam-paths.json row 'node-kinds.json'), and the tests step's commit 716de99 added its testSupportFilePatterns block, so any change to that existing exam file is an unrecognized change; the build touched it not at all. Upstream repro, one bug, checked in this round: repository git+https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik.git (issues at https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik/issues), @demlik/code-graph 0.15.0. Title: '--unreachable withholds every export of a test-support file, even one nothing uses'. Tree: package.json {"name":"repro","private":true}; tsconfig.json {"compilerOptions":{"strict":true,"module":"nodenext","noEmit":true},"include":["src/**/*.ts"]}; src/fixtures/helpers.ts with 'export const unusedHelper = (n: number) => n + 1;' and 'export const unusedValue = 1;'; src/product.ts with 'export const unusedProduct = (n: number) => n + 1;'. No config, so the default testSupportFilePatterns apply (src/fixtures/ matches test-helper-module's (^|/)fixtures?/). Command, from the tree's root: code-graph . --unreachable --json. Actual, on 0.15.0 as installed with the repo's old patch, which touches neither function: unreachable is only src/product.ts:unusedProduct (dead); withheld is src/fixtures/helpers.ts:unusedHelper, reason test-support-surface; unusedExports is empty. Expected, and what the build's patch prints: unreachable is src/fixtures/helpers.ts:unusedHelper and src/product.ts:unusedProduct, both dead; withheld is empty; unusedExports is src/fixtures/helpers.ts:constant:unusedValue. Cause: judge (src/query/unreachable.ts) and isCandidate (src/query/unused-exports.ts) both skip a test-like file before any use is counted.
